title: HeyPuter/everything
why_read: A vague, grandiose description with little concrete technical detail about what is actually being rebuilt or how.
analysis: The description claims an ambition to 'rebuild and open-source the world's software from scratch' but gives no specifics about scope, architecture, or current progress. Puter is known as a web-based desktop/OS environment project, so this may be a related initiative, but without more detail it's hard to assess technical substance. The grandiosity of the pitch outstrips the information provided to judge genuine engineering merit.
